war_summary: War 139 is on day 104 with no winner yet and 32 victory towns required. The map remains highly fragmented: many hexes are fully consolidated (Colonials hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row; Wardens hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse), while a few contested fronts dominate activity. The hottest regions over the last 24 hours are Oarbreaker (52 events, intense back-and-forth at Posterus, Partisan Island, Grisly Refuge), Endless Shore (48 events, heavy fighting at Woodbind, The Overland, The Old Jack Tar, Iron Junction), Godcrofts (24 events, mixed ownership with fighting at Saegio and Argosa), Clahstra (21 events, Colonial pressure on Warden bases like Transept and East Narthex), Mooring County (17 events, Borderlane hotspot), and Stlican Shelf (17 events, Warden-held but contested at The Old Mourn). Casualty rates are accelerating sharply in Callahan's Passage (~1200/hr per side), Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake, Onyx, Speaking Woods, and Pipers Enclave, indicating large ongoing battles even where capture events are sparse. Stema Landing shows fresh activity in the last 2 hours (7 events) around Verge Wing. Quiet rear regions show minimal activity and are unlikely to change hands in the next 24 hours.
